cli.date: YYYY-MM-DD disclosure date, mutually exclusive with range
cli.start-date/end-date: both required for a range, start <= end
cli.cursor: events-only opaque startId, suffix coverage only
cli.max-pages: optional positive caller bound, incomplete if more possible
cli.country-codes: statistics only, source comma-separated codes such as USA
cli.event-id: backtest only, exact earning_ uniqueId from source events
cli.symbols: recommendations only, tickers as context from the selected event list
cli.source-input: optional raw API envelope(s) or event array; offline completeness unknown

dataContract.pagination: complete, stoppedBecause, nextCursor, pages, resumedFromCursor; complete means requested traversal completed, not verified market-wide universe
dataContract.source: fixed API URL, requested parameters, actual transport and request interval; offline fetch times null
dataContract.backtest/recommendations: raw data, optional; internal nested schema/methodology not asserted
dataContract.units: source numeric strings parsed without percentage scaling or revenue B/M conversion; currency and time-type enum not invented
dataContract.missing: null, not zero; no fabricated surprise fields

presentation.contract: JSON data only; agent selects appropriate explanation or visualization

security: Fixed read-only GET resources after one standard ephemeral AInvest visitor session POST; credentials in memory only, no personal login/account/watchlist input, retry or synthetic fallback.

authenticationStatus.visitor: Earnings events live-verified in production on 2026-11-01 with multi-page 2026-11-02..2026-11-06 results; other operations not implied verified.
